public_rationale: The claim refers to the 'A Call for Control of Frontier AI Models' statement, launched at the UN General Assembly on 21 September 2026. Its official text calls on companies, governments, and UN member states to act. On institutions, it only asks member states to 'explore creating an international institution.' It names no funding, implementation timeline, or governance structure, and it remains open for more signatures. The US and China did not sign. So on the date of the post, how the call would be realized, financed, and governed was clearly still open, as he said.
limitations: The claim is mild and loosely worded, so 'supported' rests on a plain reading, not a measurable threshold.
The Dutch government's copy of the statement is dated 22 September; the launch was 21 September.
